findings.description: The bucket is explicitly noted and configured to be public (no ACL restricting access to private), allowing unauthenticated or unauthorized users to read/write objects, exposing potentially sensitive data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest, risking exposure of sensitive data if underlying storage is compromised.
A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, directly exposing sensitive customer data to unauthorized access.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket holding financial data, meaning objects are stored unencrypted, risking exposure of sensitive financial information.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so operational data stored in this bucket is not encrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, leaving data science datasets unencrypted at rest.
